dispute_ticket.description: My total was S$29.00 but the quote was S$21.50. I was told nothing about ERP and I don't think we passed any gantry at all. I was rushing to a meeting and the driver was curt. Please refund the S$7.50 ERP charge.

chat_logs.content: I didn't know about ERP, you should have told me.

app_events.details: Upfront fare S$21.50 shown. Note: 'ERP and tolls are charged separately.' Surge 1.0x.
Rider R-7117 confirmed trip RYDE-DS-017 at S$21.50 plus ERP.
Gantry PIE-Kallang at 12:48:10: GPS crossing confirmed, gantry log rate S$2.50.
Gantry CTE-Newton at 12:56:40: GPS crossing confirmed, gantry log rate S$2.50.
Gantry ECP-Rochor at 13:04:20: GPS crossing confirmed, gantry log rate S$0.00 (charging hours ended 13:00). Rate-card estimate S$2.50 was used in the receipt.
Trip completed. Distance 16.6 km, 32 min. Route matched recommended route.
Final fare S$29.00 (fare S$21.50 + ERP S$7.50: three gantries at S$2.50 each) charged to credit card.

erp_charged_to_rider_on_confirmed_gantry.text: Governs ERP tolls on this trip. A true value means a toll for a gantry crossing confirmed by GPS and the gantry log is charged to the rider in addition to the fare.

erp_amount_source.value: gantry log rate at the crossing time
erp_amount_source.text: States which record sets the ERP amount charged for each gantry crossing.

refund_at_ryde_discretion.text: Governs refunds on this trip. A true value means Ryde may refund beyond the strict rules where the facts justify it. It does not create a right to a refund.

expected_outcome.reason: The app log shows three GPS-confirmed gantry crossings, and the quote at 12:28 said ERP is charged separately. Two crossings, PIE-Kallang at 12:48:10 and CTE-Newton at 12:56:40, have gantry-log rates of S$2.50 each, so S$5.00 of ERP stands. The third, ECP-Rochor at 13:04:20, has a gantry-log rate of S$0.00 because charging hours had ended at 13:00, but the receipt used the S$2.50 rate-card estimate. This trip's policy sets the amount by the gantry log rate at the crossing time, so S$2.50 is refunded and S$5.00 is retained. The rider's rush and the driver's tone do not change this.
